QorCap v0.3.28: Glimpse witness on in Start Match

Start Match sets `QORCAP_GLIMPSE_FRAME=1`, starts the advisory watcher, and turns on `QORCAP_GLIMPSE_WITNESS`, `QORCAP_GLIMPSE_BURST`, and `QORCAP_GLIMPSE_ATTEST`. Caps stay $0.50 per game and $10 per week. `--no-glimpse` turns all Glimpse off. `--no-glimpse-witness`, `--no-glimpse-burst`, and `--no-glimpse-attest` each turn one switch off. The burst ring, clip audit, and touchdown veto stay off. A missing observer key is created once and a missing OpenRouter key skips witness calls; neither blocks recording. `qorcap record` stays default-off.

Also in this build, from the commits after v0.3.27:

- PR #48: opt-in per-frame capture clock (`--frame-clock`, default off) and a pause menu is no longer labeled the final screen.
- PR #49: highlight clips and Content Credentials run after the receipt is signed. `--no-auto-highlights` opts out. `qorcap clip export` stays default-off.
- PR #51: cheap-tier Glimpse witness, burst, and signed observer attestation. Observer-only. Flag-off advisory bytes stay identical.
